  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:

              description: An ID for this version of the response.

                type: string

              schema:

          headers:

              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

        - owner-v2

          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string

          content:

          content:
            application/json:

        - owners

          content:

              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

## Summary

The acceptance test creates an owner via `POST /api/owners`, then reads it back via `GET /api/owners/{id}` and asserts `$.displayName` equals `"LastName, FirstName"`. I made two minimal, well-placed changes:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a `displayName` field to the `Owner` response schema (readOnly, not part of the editable `OwnerFields`), so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added a single `@Mapping` on the existing `toOwnerDto(Owner)` method computing `displayName` as `lastName + ", " + firstName` from the stored names.

The logic lives where it belongs: the DTO shape in the OpenAPI contract, the name-to-DTO derivation in the MapStruct mapper that already owns Owner→OwnerDto conversion. No responder or function class needed changing, since every owner response already flows through `toOwnerDto`. `BUILD SUCCESS`, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.
